notes:
Mid-market product analytics company. Trial timeline: 30d Hosted API (staging) -> want proposal for Dedicated pool. Key asks: predictable tail latency <120ms p95 for chat flows, can sustain steady QPS with short bursts, clear unit economics per token and per-concurrency. AE: Avery Chen. SE: Rina Patel. CSM pre-assigned: Diego.

Trial results (observed): average qps ~ 3.2 (steady), observed burst to 18 QPS during ingestion job; avg tokens per request ~ 420 (prompt 280 / completion 140). Token mix drives cost — majority prompt tokens due to context window in support-agent flows. They run hybrid workloads: embeddings/semantic search for doc-search and chat routing for support-agent. Model preference: open models (gpt-style quantized variants) but asked about Redwood-verified quantization profiles and fallback to cheaper variants. "We need predictable latency and per-team cost breakdowns" — CTO on call.

Proof-of-concept asks: 1) Dedicated capacity sizing based on 6-month forecast, include steady vs peak sizing (QPS/concurrency), warm KV cache assumptions, and autoscale burst behaviors. 2) Traffic forecast template (hourly/day-of-week) — they will map to feature rollouts. 3) Draft pricing for Dedicated (monthly commit tiers) + cost delta with aggressive caching/quantization. 4) SSO + audit log + KMS integration sample config.

Procurement cadence: procurement + security review in parallel; legal wants DPA + KMS addendum. PO expected after internal Q2 budget review. Typical CRM shorthand in notes: "PO depends on legal signoff + 2-week canary results".

Refer to drive doc for raw telemetry: drive://redwood/deals/meridianspan/dedicated_capacity_sizing_v1.xlsx. Jira tickets open for security follow-ups: INF-5237 (KMS questions), INF-5439 (residency clarification).
